searchText: Hello guys, I am currently working on a seminar paper for a uni course. Since I could not find a paper on this, I want to * give an introduction to statelessness in ETH and Verkle trees * present implications and opportunities of the change * address current issues/challenges and point towards future research * contribute benchmarks/implementations if there is time at the end Do you see value in this work or have propositions for improval? Would love to get some feedback on this 🙂 statelessness is quite related to lightclient and Portal network, you have some presentations by Ethan (Nimbus) and Dapplion (Lodestar) at Devconnect Amseter in 2022 and Devcon 6 in Bogota. Verkle Trees, you need to look at the Hackmds by Kev, see https://github.com/mratsim/constantine/issues/182 for an overview - https://our.status.im/nimbus-fluffly/ - https://github.com/ethereum/portal-network-specs Also the discussions around the Altair hardfork introducing sync committee iirc does mention statelessness

Hello guys, I am currently working on a seminar paper for a uni course. Since I could not find a paper on this, I want to 
* give an introduction to statelessness in ETH and Verkle trees
* present implications and opportunities of the change
* address current issues/challenges and point towards future research
* contribute benchmarks/implementations if there is time at the end

Do you see value in this work or have propositions for improval? Would love to get some feedback on this 🙂
